content:
Amy - Sales: FYI — PineBank wants an air-gapped POC. Key asks: monthly hotfixes, offline KMS/HSM integration, signed delta bundles, guaranteed rollback <15m, and clarity on pricing for delta vs full bundles. They also prefer USB transfer for initial payloads. Can SE/Eng confirm feasibility and rough SOW pricing?

Ben - SolutionsEng: Got it. Quick clarifying Qs: 1) Any allowed egress at all (egress proxy)? 2) Bandwidth constraints? 3) Will customer accept a two-stage (staging -> prod) apply?

Amy - Sales: No egress. Bandwidth is low (satellite link, ~5Mbps windows). They want staging on isolated host and then cutover. USB for initial transfer is allowed.

Chris - Eng Runtime: Short answer: feasible. We support signed bundles and can produce model deltas (patches) + full blobs. For airgap best practice we recommend separating runtime image from model bundles so runtime upgrades are infrequent (full) and models can be deltified.

Chris - Eng Runtime: Example bundle layout we propose:
```
/bundles/
  runtime-1.4.2.tar.gz        (sha256:abc...)
  model-quant-v2.1.delta      (sig: sig-runtime-2026...)
  model-quant-v2.0.full       (sha256:def...)
  sbom-model-v2.1.json        (signed)
  manifest.json               (signed)
```

Laila - Security: From the SQ perspective we need: SBOMs for runtime+models, reproducible build notes, signed manifests, and a documented key provenance for signing keys. For offline KMS/HSM: we can support customer-managed HSM via PKCS#11. Important: private keys must remain in the HSM — we export only public keys for verification.

Dana - Ops: On cadence: we can do monthly hotfix windows. But delta generation + validation + signing takes time — expect ~1-2 business days for a simple delta and up to 3 days for validation on quantized blobs. For POC I'd recommend a 2-week cadence to account for approvals and airgap transfer timing.

Amy - Sales: Customer asked whether deltas reduce ops/pricing vs full bundles. They want to know if deltas are included in the POC or billed separately.

Ben - SolutionsEng: Packaging/delta generation tooling is part of our platform, but for Private/airgap deployments we typically bill initial onboarding: engineering time to configure offline signing, produce the first delta pipelines, and document the process. Estimate: 40-80 eng hours one-time (onboarding & SOW). Ongoing: 4-8 hours/month for bundle builds & verification — we can put exact line items in the SOW. USB transfer handling / chain-of-custody controls may add an extra compliance charge.

Chris - Eng Runtime: Operational note: to meet rollback <15m we require pre-staging of the previous bundle on the target disk and a tiny validation step (checksum + smoke start). The runtime supports atomic model swap if file layout follows the manifest. If they want zero-disk-change rollback, that will require more complex snapshotting (we can do but adds engineering time).

Laila - Security: Also add cert rotation schedule to the SOW: recommended 90d rotation for signing certs, and an escrow process for the signing key (customer wants escrow?). We need to provide key ceremony docs and an offline verification playbook.

Ben - SolutionsEng: For USB delivery we require signed manifests and a tamper-evident packaging checklist (hashes recorded in SOW). We can provide verification CLI that runs purely offline: `redwood-verify --manifest manifest.json --sbom sbom-model-v2.1.json`.

Amy - Sales: Customer also asked about incremental patches for quantized model weights — will quality/regression tests be needed on every delta?

Chris - Eng Runtime: Yes, minimal acceptance tests (sanity generation, latency smoke) should run for any model delta. For POC we can include a short automated prompt set run (10 prompts) as part of the validation step in the delta pipeline. That will add ~30-60m to validation per bundle.

Dana - Ops: Transfer ops: since bandwidth windows are small, recommend chunked delta files with resume support. If USB is used, include checksum sheet and a secondary verification step in the staging playbook. We'll draft an airgap transfer checklist for the runbook.

shipbot: Created ticket POC-1234 for PineBank airgap onboarding (assignee: Ben).

Amy - Sales: Action items: 1) Ben — draft SOW line items + provisional pricing for one-time onboarding + monthly maintenance, include USB/compliance add-ons. 2) Chris — outline packaging steps, validation script, and delta creation process (include sample manifest). 3) Dana — write the staging/revert playbook and chunking/resume guidance. 4) Laila — prepare KMS/HSM integration notes and SQ answers (SBOM, cert rotation, key escrow options). I will share these with the customer and schedule a call for next Wed.

Ben - SolutionsEng: Will have a SOW draft by EOD Friday.

Chris - Eng Runtime: I'll drop a PoC packaging repo link in here tomorrow with demo scripts.

Laila - Security: I'll prepare the SQ answers and key ceremony doc; ping me if they insist on vendor-hosted HSM vs customer-managed.

Dana - Ops: I'll draft the runbook and include a short checklist for USB chain-of-custody.

Amy - Sales: Perfect. @Ben @Chris @Laila @Dana thanks — please add rough estimates to the ticket so I can confirm with procurement. :thumbsup:
